name: reeschan-plugins
description: reeschan's Claude Code plugins, maintained on a fork of anthropics/claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: lens-review
plugins.description: Lens-based code review that verifies every finding before reporting it, in Japanese. Derived from Anthropic's code-review plugin.

plugins.name: public-guard
plugins.description: Stops commits, pushes, pull requests and other GitHub writes that would put words you keep private (your organization's repository names, customer names, internal names) into public repositories. The word lists stay on your machine.
